beats.text: Timi, the Afrobeats star everyone is streaming, slides into your DMs.
Saw you on Ozumba Mbadiwe last night. Backstage pass is yours tonight. Come alone.
{Partner} hasn't replied in 9 hours.

choices.label: Go backstage
choices.receipt: You went backstage with Timi.

outcomes.text: Timi sings one line to you, live. 40 people film it.
'Backstage' is a hotel lobby and a ring light. Timi asks if you have a friend.

choices.label: Screenshot it. Send it to {partner}.
choices.receipt: You sent Timi's DM to {partner}.

outcomes.text: {Partner} replies in four seconds. Funny how that works.

choices.label: Ignore him. Post a thirst trap instead.
choices.receipt: You posted a thirst trap instead of replying to Timi.

outcomes.text: Timi likes it. {Partner} likes it. Your aunty comments 'cover up'.

beats.text: Your ex. The one who 'needed space' in 2023.
I've changed. Dinner off Bourdillon? My treat. I just want to talk.

choices.label: Go. Free food is free food.
choices.receipt: You went to dinner with your ex.

outcomes.text: He has changed. Into someone who now owes you an apology and ₦40k. He pays. Shocking.
He hasn't changed. The bill comes. His card is 'at home'.

choices.label: Leave on read. Screenshot for the group chat.
choices.receipt: You left your ex on read.

outcomes.text: The group chat throws a party. Somebody makes a sticker of his face.

choices.label: Tell {partner}: "My ex is back. Should I worry?"
choices.receipt: You told {partner} about your ex.

outcomes.text: {Partner}: 'Should HE worry?' You've never been so attracted to a reply.

beats.text: A silver-haired oga sends a card to your table. The waiter won't meet your eye.
₦500k for your company this weekend. Nothing more. Probably.

choices.label: Accept. A weekend is a weekend.
choices.receipt: You took the silver-haired oga's weekend offer.

outcomes.text: He talks about golf for two days. You leave richer and very informed about golf.
His wife's cousin is at the next table. The photo travels faster than the money.

choices.label: Send the card back with a smile
choices.receipt: You declined the oga's offer.

outcomes.text: He raises his glass. Respect, and an invitation for 'another time'.

choices.label: Photograph the card. Send it to {partner}.
choices.receipt: You sent {partner} the oga's offer.

outcomes.text: {Partner} calls immediately. 'Where are you? Don't move.' It feels like being wanted.

choices.label: [Runs] "₦800k, and I bring my own driver."
choices.receipt: You negotiated the oga up to ₦800k.

outcomes.text: He agrees. Respect is a currency, and you just got paid in both.
He laughs and leaves. The waiter brings your bill. He didn't pay it.

beats.text: Morning run on the Ojuelegba bridge. Femi, your trainer, matches your pace.
Your form is perfect. My DMs are open. My schedule too.

choices.label: Flirt back. Harmless cardio.
choices.receipt: You flirted back with your trainer.

outcomes.text: Your confidence is up 40%. So is your heart rate.
Femi posts a gym selfie with you in the background, captioned 'motivation'.

choices.label: "Strictly squats, Femi."
choices.receipt: You kept it strictly squats with Femi.

outcomes.text: He respects it. He also adds 20 burpees. Petty.

choices.label: Invite {partner} to your next session
choices.receipt: You invited {partner} to the gym.

outcomes.text: {Partner} lasts six minutes. You've never laughed harder. Neither has Femi.

beats.text: Your boss invites you to a 'strategy dinner'. Candles. One other chair.
Let's discuss your promotion. Somewhere more relaxed.

choices.label: Go. It's about the promotion. Right?
choices.receipt: You went to the 'strategy dinner'.

outcomes.text: It was about the promotion. Mostly. You get it.
outcomes.work_note: Got promoted at a candlelit 'strategy dinner'.

outcomes.text: It was not about the promotion. You leave before dessert. Monday will be awkward.
outcomes.work_note: Walked out on the boss's 'strategy dinner'.

choices.label: "Let's discuss it in the office. 9am."
choices.receipt: You told your boss to discuss it at the office.

outcomes.text: 9am. HR is in the meeting. You get half the raise and all the respect.

choices.label: Bring {partner} as your 'plus one'
choices.receipt: You brought {partner} to your boss's dinner.

outcomes.text: Your boss and {partner} compare watches for two hours. You eat alone, promoted by default.
outcomes.work_note: Got promoted because the boss liked {partner}'s watch.

beats.text: Ozumba Mbadiwe. Kayode, the loudest Benz in Lekki, sends a bottle to your table with sparklers.
Whoever they are, they're not giving you sparklers. I'm giving you sparklers.

choices.label: Dance with Kayode. One song.
choices.receipt: You danced with Kayode.

outcomes.text: One song becomes four. The DJ shouts you out. You feel like a music video.
Sirens outside. Kayode is gone before the chorus. The ₦640k tab is on your table.

choices.label: Send the bottle back. Keep the sparklers.
choices.receipt: You sent Kayode's bottle back.

outcomes.text: Kayode laughs, impressed. 'Hard. I like hard.' You like that he leaves.

choices.label: Take a picture of the bottle for {partner}
choices.receipt: You sent {partner} a picture of Kayode's bottle.

outcomes.text: {Partner} replies with a voice note. Tone: unreadable. Volume: high.

beats.text: LASTMA stops the car at Ojuelegba. {Partner} is driving. The officer leans in.
You crossed the yellow line. Come down. Or... find something for the boys.

choices.label: Pay "something for the boys". ₦10k.
choices.receipt: You paid LASTMA something for the boys.

outcomes.text: Smooth. The officer salutes. {Partner} says 'you didn't have to.' You did.

choices.label: Argue. Loudly. Quote the traffic law.
choices.receipt: You argued with LASTMA on the road.

outcomes.text: The officer gives up. Danfo drivers applaud you.
Forty minutes. A crowd. A TikTok. The car is towed anyway.

choices.label: Sit back. Let {partner} handle it.
choices.receipt: You let {partner} handle LASTMA.

outcomes.text: {Partner} handles it with a handshake you're not meant to see. Everything is a transaction.

beats.text: A video of you and {partner} arguing at a Lekki petrol station is on the Parlour. 30k views. Someone added sad violin music.

choices.label: Repost it with "Lagos love is a contact sport"
choices.receipt: You reposted your viral argument.

outcomes.text: The Parlour loves you. Brands want to 'collab'.
{Partner} did not find it funny. At all.

choices.label: Report it. Beg the uploader. Pay if needed.
choices.receipt: You paid to take the viral video down.

outcomes.text: Gone in an hour. The screenshots are forever, but the violin is gone.

choices.label: Log off. Touch grass. Third Mainland grass.
choices.receipt: You logged off when you went viral.

outcomes.text: By evening, a different couple is trending. Lagos moves fast.

beats.text: The bill comes: ₦380k. {Partner} went to the toilet fifteen minutes ago. The waiter is standing very close.

choices.label: Pay it. Post the receipt later as evidence.
choices.broke_text: Your card would decline in front of the waiter. Not today.
choices.receipt: You paid the bill when {partner} disappeared.

outcomes.text: {Partner} returns: 'Ah, you paid? You shouldn't have!' {He} lets you, though.

choices.label: Pay your half only. ₦20k. Leave.
choices.receipt: You paid your half of the bill and left.

outcomes.text: You leave the other half and your dignity intact. {Partner} calls twice. You don't pick.

choices.label: Go knock on the toilet door
choices.receipt: You knocked on the toilet door for {partner}.

outcomes.text: {Partner} comes out 'on a call'. Pays. Glares. The whole restaurant watched.

beats.text: Mercy, Lekki's hustle queen, slides into your booth uninvited.
I know {partner} well. Very well. Do you want the gist, or do you want to stay happy?

choices.label: "Give me the gist."
choices.receipt: You took gist from Mercy.

outcomes.text: Mercy whispers for five minutes. Half is true. You can't tell which half.

choices.label: Throw your drink. Lagos style.
choices.receipt: You threw your drink at Mercy.

outcomes.text: The booth gasps. Mercy laughs, wet and delighted. Phones are already out.

choices.label: "I'll stay happy, thanks." Turn your back.
choices.receipt: You turned your back on Mercy's gist.

outcomes.text: Mercy shrugs and leaves. Her perfume stays. So does the question.

beats.text: Blessing the promoter is on IG Live. She's holding up your name.
This one booked a table with {partner} and didn't pay the deposit. Twenty-four hours, or I'm posting faces.

choices.label: Pay the deposit. ₦50k. End it.
choices.receipt: You paid Blessing's table deposit.

outcomes.text: Blessing ends the live: 'Paid. Respect.' You are now on her 'good list'. Scary list.

choices.label: Forward it to {partner}: "Your table, your wahala."
choices.receipt: You forwarded Blessing's live to {partner}.

outcomes.text: {Partner} pays and sends you a flower emoji. Crisis outsourced.
{Partner}: 'What table?' Blessing posts your face at midnight.

choices.label: Go live yourself. Drag her back.
choices.receipt: You went live to drag Blessing back.

outcomes.text: Two lives. 9,000 viewers. Nobody wins. Everybody watches.

beats.text: Your ex's wedding owambe in Surulere. You came with {partner}. The aso-ebi is loud. So are the aunties.
Ah. You came. With... wow. Okay.

choices.label: Spray the couple. Big notes. Big smile.
choices.receipt: You sprayed your ex at his own wedding.

outcomes.text: The videographer zooms in. You won the wedding. It wasn't yours.

choices.label: Drop a ₦5k envelope in the gift box
choices.receipt: You gave your ex a ₦5k envelope.

outcomes.text: Your name is on the envelope in very large letters. Petty, but polite.

choices.label: Dance with {partner} in front of the high table
choices.receipt: You danced with {partner} at your ex's wedding.

outcomes.text: The aunties approve. One asks {partner} for a business card.
{Partner} trips over a cooler of zobo. The video has a remix by morning.

choices.label: Eat the small chops. Leave early.
choices.receipt: You left your ex's wedding early.

outcomes.text: You took a takeaway pack. Peace, and puff-puff.

beats.text: NEPA takes light mid-sentence. Pitch black. The generator coughs, then roars. {Partner} is laughing in the dark.

choices.label: Use the dark. Steal a kiss.
choices.receipt: You kissed {partner} when NEPA took light.

outcomes.text: The generator is loud. Your heartbeat is louder.

choices.label: Phone torch on. Candid photo of {partner}.
choices.receipt: You took a candid photo by torchlight.

outcomes.text: The best photo anyone's ever taken of {him}. {He} asks you not to post it. You don't.

choices.label: "Who bought fuel this week?" Start the audit.
choices.receipt: You audited the generator fuel.

outcomes.text: The audit reveals: nobody. The generator dies. You both laugh until NEPA returns.

beats.text: Third Mainland Bridge. Not moving. You're meant to meet {partner} in 20 minutes. Your danfo driver has turned off the engine to 'save fuel'.

choices.label: Jump on an okada. Risk it.
choices.receipt: You jumped on an okada through traffic.

outcomes.text: You arrive early. Windblown. Iconic.
The okada nearly clips a BRT. You arrive with one shoe and a new religion.

choices.label: Send {partner} a voice note of the traffic
choices.receipt: You sent {partner} a voice note from traffic.

outcomes.text: {He} replies: 'Lagos.' Just 'Lagos.' Love language unlocked.

choices.label: Cancel. Go home. Lagos won.
choices.receipt: You cancelled because of traffic.

outcomes.text: {Partner} is gracious about it. Suspiciously gracious.

beats.text: Rain floods the Lekki-Epe Expressway. Cars are boats now. {Partner} offers to send a driver. In a Prado. Through a river.

choices.label: Accept the driver. Arrive like royalty.
choices.receipt: You let {partner}'s driver rescue you from the flood.

outcomes.text: Water to the doors, AC on full. Somehow romantic.

choices.label: Wade through. Shoes in hand. Independent.
choices.receipt: You waded through the flood yourself.

outcomes.text: You post a video wading through Lekki. 'Soft life,' you caption it. The Parlour dies laughing.

choices.label: Stay home. Indomie and Netflix.
choices.receipt: You stayed home during the flood.

outcomes.text: The best date you've had all week, and it was with yourself.

beats.text: Emergency meeting. Tonight. 8pm. Everybody.
Tonight is the night {partner} finally invited you to {his} place in Ikoyi.

choices.label: Go to the meeting. Rent is rent.
choices.receipt: You chose the emergency meeting over {partner}.

outcomes.text: You save the quarter. {Partner} sends 'ok.' with a full stop.
outcomes.work_note: Saved the quarter, lost the vibe.

choices.label: Skip it. "I'm sick." Go to Ikoyi.
choices.receipt: You faked sick to go to {partner}'s.

outcomes.text: Nobody notices. The night is worth it.
Your MD sees your status. From Ikoyi. Promotion: postponed.
outcomes.work_note: Lost a promotion for a night in Ikoyi.

choices.label: Join the meeting on mute from {partner}'s sofa
choices.receipt: You joined the work meeting from {partner}'s sofa.

outcomes.text: Multitasking legend. Camera off, heart on.
You unmute by accident. Your MD hears {partner} ask 'who is that man shouting?'

beats.text: Babe. BABE. My own man is cheating. I'm outside his house. Bring a bat. Or wine. Or both.

choices.label: Go. Bring both.
choices.receipt: You dropped everything for your Bestie's crisis.

outcomes.text: You spend the night on her floor. {Partner} texts 'where are you' three times.

choices.label: Stay on the phone. Talk her down.
choices.receipt: You talked your Bestie down on the phone.

outcomes.text: Two hours. She goes home. You're exhausted and a saint.

choices.label: "Babe, I'm on a date. Call you at 10."
choices.receipt: You put your Bestie on hold for a date.

outcomes.text: She sends 'ok' with no emoji. You'll pay for that later. Probably in wine.
She posts a sad status about 'fake friends'. Your mutuals have questions.

choices.label: "Before the bat: what gist did you hear about {partner}?"
choices.receipt: You asked your Bestie to explain her gist about {partner}.

outcomes.text: She stops crying instantly. 'Oh, THAT gist.' She tells it again, louder, with new details.

beats.text: The Parlour: 'Someone on Admiralty Way is dating a {partner} lookalike. Spill?' Your bestie tags you. Seven times.

choices.label: Spill. Anonymously. Mostly.
choices.receipt: You spilled gist about {partner} on the Parlour.

outcomes.text: The thread hits 1,000 comments. Anonymous lasted eleven minutes.

choices.label: Untag yourself. Mute the thread.
choices.receipt: You muted the Parlour thread.

outcomes.text: Silence. Your bestie calls you 'boring'. You're boring and safe.

choices.label: Post a decoy. Different area, different hair.
choices.receipt: You posted a decoy in the Parlour.

outcomes.text: The Parlour chases a girl in Ikeja for two days. Sorry, Ikeja girl.
Someone recognises your writing style. 'Babe, we know it's you.'

beats.text: Your neighbour hands you her phone. It's Mama Nonso. On speaker. For you.
My daughter! Are you married? My son Nonso is a doctor. Almost. He's single. Very single.

choices.label: "I'm seeing someone, Mama."
choices.receipt: You told Mama Nonso you're taken.

outcomes.text: 'Seeing is not marrying!' She adds you to her prayer list anyway.

choices.label: Take Nonso's number. For research.
choices.receipt: You took Nonso's number.

outcomes.text: Nonso texts in 30 seconds: 'Mummy said you're my wife.' Delete or keep? Keep.

choices.label: "Mama, pray for my current relationship."
choices.receipt: You asked Mama Nonso to pray for your relationship.

outcomes.text: She prays for 14 minutes on speaker. A danfo conductor says 'Amen' from the road.

beats.text: Ojuelegba at night. An okada nearly clips you. Your phone flies. It lands screen-up: a text from {partner}. 'Where are you?'

choices.label: "Ojuelegba. Nearly died. Love you."
choices.receipt: You told {partner} you nearly got hit.

outcomes.text: {Partner} calls immediately. Real worry. It feels good to be worried about.

choices.label: "At home. Sleeping."
choices.receipt: You told {partner} you were home when you weren't.

outcomes.text: 'Okay, sleep well.' The lie works. You feel weird about how easily.
'Funny. I can hear okadas.' Oops.

choices.label: Ignore it. Buy suya. Survive first.
choices.receipt: You ignored {partner}'s text and bought suya.

outcomes.text: The suya man gives you extra yaji 'for shock'. Medicine.

beats.text: Good morning. Your loan is overdue. We have messaged your contacts. Your mother says hello. So does your MD.

choices.label: Repay what you can. Right now.
choices.receipt: You repaid the loan app.

outcomes.text: Partial payment. They stop calling your mother. They keep calling you.

choices.label: Block the number. They have 40 more.
choices.receipt: You blocked the loan app's recovery line.

outcomes.text: They message your family WhatsApp: 'This person is a debtor. Pray for them.' Your aunty prays loudly.

choices.label: Ask {partner} to clear it
choices.receipt: You asked {partner} to clear your loan.

outcomes.text: {Partner} clears it without a word. You feel rescued and owned at the same time.
'A loan app? You?' {Partner} looks at you differently now.

beats.text: You wake up. One lash is in your eye. The other side of your face is having a different day. {Partner} wants a video call.

choices.label: Sunglasses indoors. Confidence.
choices.receipt: You hid the botched glow-up behind sunglasses.

outcomes.text: 'Why are you in sunglasses?' 'I'm photosensitive.' You are not.

choices.label: Pay to fix it. Awolowo Road, properly.
choices.receipt: You paid to fix the botched job.

outcomes.text: Fixed. Expensive lesson: the cheap one costs twice.

choices.label: Video call anyway. Laugh first.
choices.receipt: You showed {partner} the botched job and laughed.

outcomes.text: {Partner} laughs so hard {he} snorts. Intimacy unlocked.
{Partner} screenshots it. For 'memories'. It's in a group chat by noon.

beats.text: A text from the stranger who shared your booth last night.
Last night was fun. Same booth tonight? I'll be there by 11. Bring your energy.

choices.label: Go back. Just to dance.
choices.receipt: You went back to the club for the stranger.

outcomes.text: Just to dance becomes just one drink becomes just one photo.

choices.label: Leave him on read
choices.receipt: You ignored the stranger from the club.

outcomes.text: He sends a sad emoji at 2am. Then a 'wyd'. Then nothing. Peace.

choices.label: Tell {partner} someone's trying you
choices.receipt: You told {partner} a stranger was trying you.

outcomes.text: {Partner} goes quiet, then: 'Which club?' The question has teeth.

beats.text: A blog posts the photo: you and Tunde, VIP booth, sparklers. {Partner} sends you the link. No caption.
Explain this.

choices.label: "I danced. That's all. I'm sorry I didn't say."
choices.receipt: You told {partner} the truth about the club photo.

outcomes.text: Silence. Then: 'Okay.' Not fine. But okay.

choices.label: "That's not me. Lagos has twins."
choices.receipt: You denied the club photo.

outcomes.text: {Partner} zooms in on your bag. {He} bought you that bag.

choices.label: "Where were YOU on Friday?"
choices.receipt: You flipped the club photo into an accusation.

outcomes.text: The fight lasts till 3am. Nobody wins. Everybody's tired.

beats.text: Headline: 'TIMI SPOTTED WITH MYSTERY LOVER BACKSTAGE'. {Partner} has read it. Twice.
So. Timi.

choices.label: "It was a photo. Nothing happened."
choices.receipt: You told {partner} nothing happened with Timi.

outcomes.text: {Partner} wants to believe you. {He} almost does.

choices.label: "Jealous? Timi has taste."
choices.receipt: You flexed Timi at {partner}.

outcomes.text: {Partner} laughs, but not with you. Clout up. Something else down.

choices.label: "I was bored and you weren't answering."
choices.receipt: You told {partner} you went because {he} wasn't answering.

outcomes.text: That lands. Hard. On both of you.

beats.text: The Parlour: 'Saw somebody's somebody out with somebody else this week 👀.' The picture is blurry. Your outfit is not.

choices.label: Comment "Lagos is small 😂" and move on
choices.receipt: You laughed off the Parlour post about you.

outcomes.text: Bold. It works on everybody except the three people who know you.

choices.label: Tell {partner} first, before the Parlour does
choices.receipt: You told {partner} before the Parlour could.

outcomes.text: {Partner} is annoyed, then grateful. 'At least you told me.' Honesty: expensive but cheaper.

choices.label: Pay the Parlour admin to delete it
choices.receipt: You paid the Parlour admin to delete the post.

outcomes.text: Deleted. Admin says 'pleasure doing business'. Chilling.
Admin deletes it, then posts 'someone paid me to delete a post 👀'. Worse.

beats.text: Babe. A blog is putting together a thread about you. Pictures, names, timeline. You have a few hours.

choices.label: Lay low. Delete. Private account. Pray.
choices.receipt: You went private when a blog came for you.

outcomes.text: You vanish for a day. The blog finds a juicier story. Thank God for other people's wahala.

choices.label: Pay the blog to kill it
choices.receipt: You paid a blog to kill a story about you.

outcomes.text: Killed. Blogs, like everything in Lagos, have a price.
They take the money and run the story anyway. With a watermark.

choices.label: Feed them a bigger story about someone else
choices.receipt: You fed a blog someone else's gist to save yourself.

outcomes.text: It works. Somebody else trends. Your karma just opened a tab.

beats.text: Mid-date with {partner}. Your phone lights up on the table: 'NONSO (MAMA'S SON)'. {Partner} reads it upside down.
Who is Nonso? And why is his mama involved?

choices.label: "His mother is trying to marry me off."
choices.receipt: You explained Nonso to {partner}.

outcomes.text: {Partner} laughs so hard the waiter laughs too. Then: 'Block him. Respectfully.'

choices.label: Decline the call. Smile. Change the subject.
choices.receipt: You declined Nonso's call mid-date.

outcomes.text: Smooth. Nonso sends 'ok ma'. Of course he does.
He calls again. And again. Mama is clearly coaching him.

choices.label: Answer it. Put Nonso on speaker.
choices.receipt: You put Nonso on speaker on your date.

outcomes.text: 'Good evening, my future wife.' The table goes silent. The pepper soup goes cold.

beats.text: {Partner}'s driver mentions, casually, that he saw you at Ojuelegba the night you were 'sleeping'.
So. You were home?

choices.label: "I wasn't. I didn't want a lecture."
choices.receipt: You admitted you lied about where you were.

outcomes.text: 'Next time, just tell me.' The car feels smaller, but it's still moving.

choices.label: Double down. "Your driver needs glasses."
choices.receipt: You doubled down on the location lie.

outcomes.text: The driver suddenly can't remember anything. Loyal man.
The driver shows a photo. Your hair is unmistakable.

choices.label: "Why is your driver tracking me?"
choices.receipt: You asked why {partner}'s driver was watching you.

outcomes.text: {Partner} has no good answer to that. Neither of you sleeps well.

beats.text: Babe, I'm coming with my friends. Just four. They're hungry. Is that ok? 🥺
You booked a table for two. The menu has no prices, which means the prices are violent.

choices.label: "Bring them. I'm a big person."
choices.receipt: You fed {partner}'s four friends.

outcomes.text: The friends love you. One of them is now your biggest defender in the group chat.
The friends order cocktails in pairs. Nobody says thank you. One asks for 'takeaway for my sister'.

choices.label: "Everybody pays for themselves. Lagos rules."
choices.receipt: You told {partner}'s friends to pay their own bills.

outcomes.text: The friends go quiet. {Partner} laughs, then respects you a little more, then a little less.

choices.label: "Table for two. Tell them happy weekend."
choices.receipt: You kept the date to two.

outcomes.text: {Partner} arrives alone, slightly annoyed, then stays till closing. Worth it.

choices.label: [Big Boy] Book the whole section. Invite their friends' friends.
choices.receipt: You booked the whole section for {partner}'s friends.

outcomes.text: You are now a legend in a group chat you're not in.

beats.text: Sweetheart, my third sister's birthday is Saturday. You know how family is. Something small. Like ₦50k. Or a cake. Or both.

choices.label: Send a nice cake with her name on it
choices.receipt: You sent a cake for {partner}'s third sister.

outcomes.text: The sister posts the cake with 'my in-law 😍'. You have been promoted without an interview.

choices.label: Send the ₦50k. Family is family.
choices.receipt: You sent ₦50k for the third sister's birthday.

outcomes.text: Thank-you voice notes from three sisters. All of them have birthdays this month, apparently.
The 'sister' has had four birthdays this year. You've funded two.

choices.label: "Which number sister is this again?"
choices.receipt: You asked which sister was having a birthday.

outcomes.text: {Partner} sends a family photo. There are seven sisters. It is a real question.

beats.text: Before we go out tomorrow. Here's my account number. For transport. And 'getting ready'. You understand. 😘

choices.label: Send transport money. It's Lagos.
choices.receipt: You sent {partner} transport money before the date.

outcomes.text: {Partner} arrives on time, looking expensive. The ₦10k was a good investment.
{Partner} arrives by keke. The transport money became a wig deposit.

choices.label: "I'll send a ride to your gate."
choices.receipt: You booked {partner} a ride instead of sending cash.

outcomes.text: {Partner} sends 'ok' with one full stop. The ride was free. The full stop was not.

choices.label: Send back your own account number
choices.receipt: You sent {partner} your own account number back.

outcomes.text: Three minutes of silence. Then a laughing emoji. Then ₦2k, 'for your own transport'. Respect.
